metadata.scope: Only unresolved dynamic margins, cells or caller-to-widget mappings; static widths alone do not grant approval.
measurement_steps: Open the named screen on the existing Batch 04 ROM; leave the cursor, values and icons visible.
Capture the full 240x160 mGBA frame at native resolution, without crop or scaling.
Mark screen x coordinates for outer window edges, first glyph, cursor/right value and final glyph.
For a dynamic-name case, repeat with a maximum-length legal name and record the name and save state.
Record actual screen/caller identity; a screenshot by itself does not prove a different ROM entry is used.

cases.screen: Ordinary battle message after a nickname-dependent status/ability message
cases.how_to_reach: Trigger the corresponding sleep/ability message; exact battle setup is not yet traced.
cases.english_baseline_text: The original ROM entry at 0x003FB565; confirm the actual displayed line before using this case.
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Longest local nickname, wild/trainer prefix, final glyph/right margin and FE line boundary.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Confirm actual entry and prefix consumer; show the maximal displayed expansion fits without clipped last glyph.

cases.screen: Field dialogue containing [player] immediately before a page transition
cases.how_to_reach: Use a progressed save at this script event; exact map/flag path is unverified.
cases.english_baseline_text: Original field script at ROM 0x01F3E84E; verify the speaker before measuring.
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Dialogue boundaries, seven-character player name, FE/FA transition in separate frames.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Identify this script's live renderer and margin; confirm page transition with maximal local player name.

cases.screen: Normal battle: FIGHT / POKéMON / BAG / RUN
cases.how_to_reach: Start any normal battle and leave the four commands and selector visible.
cases.english_baseline_text: FIGHT / POKéMON / BAG / RUN (confirm which of the three Unbound action strings is live).
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Both column origins, cursor space and last-glyph right margin; source has FC 13 38.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Match live variant to ROM pointer and measure effective cell widths within physical 56/40px spans.

cases.screen: Safari battle: Ball / Bait / Rock / Run
cases.how_to_reach: Enter the Safari-style battle mode; route to it is not yet confirmed.
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: First/second column glyph origin and selector/right margin.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Confirm Safari path shares window 2 and measure its effective column cells.

cases.screen: Pause menu > Options, with a label and its current value on one row
cases.how_to_reach: Open the pause menu and choose Options; leave the selected row/value visible.
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Label/value column split, selector or arrow width, right padding.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Prove separate label and value usable widths, not the full 200px physical span.

cases.screen: Pause menu > Game Settings > difficulty selection
cases.how_to_reach: Open pause menu > Game Settings and highlight the difficulty choice.
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Actual choice widget and title/help/value widths with selector visible.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Map script bufferstring operand to the live widget and measure its content area.

cases.screen: Pokémon Center PC > Item Storage > action menu
cases.how_to_reach: Use a Pokémon Center PC, open Item Storage and show the Deposit/Withdraw menu.
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Action menu text origin, selector area and right padding within 13 tiles.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Confirm the 13-tile template is the live action menu and derive safe label width.

cases.screen: Pokémon Center PC > Pokémon Storage box operations
cases.how_to_reach: Open Pokémon Storage from a PC and display the box/action labels.
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Separate box label, action list and message dimensions; do not reuse item-storage width.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Identify live entry/widget and measure each distinct PC text region.

cases.screen: Bag/Cube sort, pocket or context popup
cases.how_to_reach: Open the Bag/Cube, select an item and display the context/sort popup.
cases.english_baseline_text: Type (Cube sort option; confirm the live entry).
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Separate item row/quantity, pocket tab, description and context popup bounds.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Measure each widget and identify pointers; do not assign a shared Bag width.

cases.screen: Early script choice menu with two or more choices
cases.how_to_reach: Start NEW GAME and reach a visible multi-choice script menu; record exact prompt/options.
cases.english_baseline_text: Record the English choices shown; source entry and window-sizing path are not yet proven.
cases.screenshot_measurement_needed: Window growth, cursor width, left/right padding and maximum screen edge.
cases.what_would_resolve_ambiguity: Identify the script choice opcode/helper and compare windows for short versus long labels.
